name: OmaGAWD
author: David
description: Winamp soul. Omarchy fit. Badass llama dance moves. Jellyfin, local music and worldwide radio in a compact player that follows your theme. Real frequency spectrum, keyboard control, saved playlists and update notices. Discover stations by name, genre, country or language; save favourites or add a stream link. Tab and arrows browse; Return plays; Alt+Return adds. The player llama rotates through running man, side shuffle, head banging and twerk; the bar icon stays still.

barWidget.description: Llama button for Jellyfin, local music and live radio
